name: invio-website
description: Official product landing page and info website for Invio Desktop application by Timrio

scripts.prebuild: node -e "import('fs').then((fs) => { if (fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); })"
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && git push origin main
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && git push origin main
scripts.release:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && git push origin main
